title: Install Metasploit Framework
explanation: Install the Kali package if missing.
options: Review dependencies before accepting. Use apt update first if indexes are stale.

title: Launch the console
explanation: Open Metasploit without its startup banner.
options: Type subsequent msfconsole examples inside this console, not in Bash or Zsh.

title: List available console commands
explanation: Display commands available in the current console context.
options: This is the installed version's command inventory; module and extension commands can vary.

title: Check the Framework version
explanation: Display installed Framework and console versions.
options: Record this with reports because modules and syntax evolve.

title: Search command help
explanation: Inspect search filters supported by this installation.
options: Use local help when examples differ from your version.

title: Find HTTP version scanners
explanation: Filter the module catalog.
options: type limits module class; name narrows the match. Searching does not execute modules.

title: Read module information
explanation: Inspect an HTTP fingerprint module.
options: Review requirements and references before selecting a module.

title: Select the HTTP scanner
explanation: Activate a module's console context.
options: Selection itself does not run the scanner.
result: The prompt includes the module name.

title: Show module options
explanation: Inspect required and optional settings.
options: Examples below assume the HTTP version scanner is selected.

title: List missing required values
explanation: Display required settings that are unset.
options: A complete option set is not proof the target or action is correct.

title: Set a local target
explanation: Select this Kali VM as the scanner target.
options: RHOSTS means target hosts; localhost does not mean your Windows host.

title: Set the lab port
explanation: Select the web port from Guided Lab 07.
options: RPORT is the destination service port.

title: Keep one scanner thread
explanation: Limit this scanner's parallel work.
options: Not every module exposes THREADS.

title: Read a selected setting
explanation: Display the current target setting.
options: Check effective options before execution.

title: Clear a module setting
explanation: Remove the local target value.
options: A global value or default can still apply; recheck show options.

title: Return to the main console
explanation: Leave the selected module context.
options: This does not automatically terminate background jobs.

title: Inspect advanced settings
explanation: List additional module options.
options: Change only settings you understand. Options depend on the selected module.

title: List supported actions
explanation: Inspect actions implemented by the selected module.
options: Some modules have one action or no selectable actions.

title: Inspect target profiles
explanation: List profiles supported by a selected exploit module.
options: Profiles are platform or application variants, not discovered host addresses. This does not execute an exploit.

title: Inspect compatible payloads
explanation: List payloads compatible with the selected exploit context.
options: A list does not create or deploy a payload. Availability depends on module and platform.

title: Set global verbosity
explanation: Set a global diagnostic preference.
options: Global settings may affect later modules. Avoid global target defaults for unrelated labs.

title: Read global verbosity
explanation: Inspect the global value.
options: A module-specific setting can override a global value.

title: Clear global verbosity
explanation: Remove the global override.
options: Subsequent behavior depends on module-specific values and defaults.

title: Run the localhost HTTP fingerprint lab
command:
use auxiliary/scanner/http/http_version
set RHOSTS 127.0.0.1
set RPORT 8000
set THREADS 1
set SSL false
show options
run
explanation: Send an HTTP fingerprint request to your own training server.
options: Start Guided Lab 07 first. Review each line; run executes the selected module.
result: A server fingerprint if the service responds.

title: Learn check behavior
explanation: Read help for a module's check operation.
options: Actual check sends module-defined probes and is not universally harmless. Not all modules implement it.
result: Help text or an unsupported-context message.

title: Database management help
explanation: Inspect the Kali database wrapper's commands.
options: Kali packaging can differ from standalone Rapid7 installers.

title: Inspect database service status
explanation: Check local Metasploit database setup.
options: Run in Kali Terminal, outside msfconsole.

title: Initialize a first database
explanation: Create the local database configuration when it has not been initialized.
options: Check status first. This changes local services and creates database resources; it is not a repair command for every connection error.

title: Check the database connection
explanation: Check whether this console is connected to a database.
options: Service running and console connected are different conditions.

title: List workspaces
explanation: List workspaces and identify the current one.
options: Requires a working database connection.

title: Create a practice workspace
explanation: Create a workspace for the book exercises.
options: Separates recorded findings, not network permissions.

title: Select the practice workspace
explanation: Change the active workspace.
options: Create it first and verify with workspace before importing results.

title: List recorded hosts
explanation: Show hosts in the current workspace.
options: A record may be historical; it does not prove a host is online now.

title: List recorded services
explanation: Show service records.
options: Results depend on prior scans and imports.

title: Filter recorded services by port
explanation: Show records for the lab port.
options: This queries the database rather than scanning.

title: List recorded findings
explanation: Inspect vulnerability records in the workspace.
options: Records can be incomplete or require manual validation.

title: List recorded notes
explanation: Inspect workspace notes.
options: Some modules add notes; an empty workspace may show none.

title: Scan localhost into the database
explanation: Run a focused Nmap scan and record its results.
options: Requires Nmap and a connected database. Start the local web service first.
result: Port results and stored service data.

title: Import an Nmap XML report
explanation: Import a previously generated report.
options: Create this exact file in the guided Metasploit lab first. Check workspace before importing.

title: Read export options
explanation: Inspect export formats supported by this build.
options: Review reports for sensitive information before sharing.

title: List background jobs
explanation: List background tasks and their identifiers.
options: Jobs and interactive sessions are different objects.

title: Inspect one job
explanation: Read details for a job you identified.
options: Replace 0 with an ID from jobs -l.
result: Job details or no such job.

title: Stop one selected job
explanation: Stop a particular background job.
options: Verify the ID first; stopping a listener or scan interrupts it.

title: List established sessions
explanation: List current session identifiers.
options: The localhost HTTP lab creates no session. Session examples require a separately established, authorized training session.

title: Inspect session command options
explanation: Read supported session-management flags.
options: Use IDs returned by the current console.

title: Interact with a lab session
explanation: Enter an existing authorized lab session.
options: Replace 1 with a verified session ID. The resulting prompt depends on session type.

title: List session commands
explanation: List commands supported by this Meterpreter session.
options: Commands depend on platform and loaded extensions; this is not the msfconsole help list.

title: Read lab system information
explanation: Ask the lab session for basic system details.
options: Requires the relevant standard API support.

title: Identify session identity
explanation: Read the session's current account identity.
options: This reports identity; it does not grant extra privileges.

title: Read remote working directory
explanation: Show the current directory on the lab session's machine.
options: This differs from your local Kali directory.

title: List a lab directory
explanation: List the current remote directory.
options: Inspect only the intended practice location.

title: Read local working directory
explanation: Show the local directory used by Meterpreter's client.
options: Local means the Kali machine hosting Metasploit.

title: List lab processes
explanation: Request the remote process list.
options: Process visibility depends on session privileges and platform.

title: Return without closing the session
explanation: Return control to msfconsole.
options: The session remains available; backgrounding is not termination.

title: Start a console transcript
explanation: Record console output to a file.
options: Create the private lab directory first. Transcripts can contain sensitive results.

title: Stop a console transcript
explanation: Stop recording console output.
options: The existing transcript remains on disk.

title: Replay a reviewed resource file
explanation: Execute a file containing console commands.
options: Create the read-only script from the guided lab. Resource files can execute powerful actions; inspect contents first.

title: Start with a resource script
explanation: Launch the console and replay the reviewed file.
options: -r chooses a resource file; it is not a report-reading option.

title: Reload installed modules
explanation: Reload module definitions.
options: Useful during module development; it does not download updates and may take time.

title: Inspect msfvenom help
explanation: Read the payload utility's command reference.
options: This help-only command generates no executable or payload.

title: Exit the framework console
explanation: Leave Metasploit.
options: Review active jobs and sessions first; exiting can interrupt them.
